faqs.question: How long does implementation take?
faqs.answer: Most teams are live in under two weeks. Connect your ATS, import the role and rubric, and run the first requisition in parallel with your current process — no migration project required.

faqs.question: Does TalentPool365 replace our ATS?
faqs.answer: No. It sits on top of the ATS you already run. Candidates, stages and offers stay in your system of record; the platform handles sourcing, screening and interview evidence, then syncs both ways.

faqs.question: How do you keep the AI from making biased decisions?
faqs.answer: Every score is tied to a rubric your team defined before the role opened. Models are bias-audited quarterly, and no candidate is auto-rejected — a recruiter reviews the evidence and makes the call.

faqs.question: What happens to candidate data?
faqs.answer: It stays yours. SOC 2 Type II controls, GDPR-compliant processing, EU data residency on request, and candidate data is never used to train shared models. Enterprise plans add SSO/SAML and full audit trails.

faqs.question: Can we try it on a real role first?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 14-day trial includes sourcing and screening on live requisitions, no card required. For larger teams we'll set up a sandbox pilot on your own data before you commit.

faqs.question: How is pricing counted?
faqs.answer: Plans are priced by active job roles, not per seat — your whole hiring panel can review candidates on one subscription. Annual billing saves 20%, and Enterprise is quoted on volume and regions.
